rapport_notes: Brianne is warm, patient, validates customer concerns repeatedly, uses humor, and builds genuine connection throughout.
process_discipline_notes: Rep does not hold silence after the 'Does that all make sense?' question at the estimate (immediately launches into explanation).

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I'll get started with a few questions to get on the right track. It should take about five minutes and then we'll be able to go over everything.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Do you have any specific questions or concerns in regards to this move specifically?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'The only thing that and I put this in the notes is my entrance...' Rep: 'Okay, Okay.' Customer: 'My stairs are steep but they are stairs and they're both on the second floor... just completely different buildings, not next to each other.' Rep acknowledges and follows with unit number questions to capture the details.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Rep acknowledges tight entrance and takes notes: 'Definitely, appreciate that and I will estimate the time into that and make notes and then, and make a note that you are understanding of that just in case.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: A typical move obviously, this size takes two movers, one truck between three and five hours... I would look to budget between $936 and $1045...' (anchoring and personalizing time to their situation).
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Obviously there's number of factors involved in determining your move time but the most important one is how well prepared you are when we get there.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: If we can finish this in fifteen minutes we don't have to charge you for like the hour... you only, you know, pay for the time that we're there.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: If you are able to consolidate things in the boxes and even if you have the ability to take some of the smaller things over yourself in a car loader too, that really help to keep the time down.

top_strength: Brianne expertfully builds trust and surfaces customer concerns by validating them repeatedly, taking notes, and demonstrating genuine care—she captures the tight entrance and stairs details through patient two-layer follow-up that shows the customer she's listening.
coaching_note: Missing Communication differentiator (day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates) entirely, and never attempts a rate-lock close or explicit ask to book; also add a pause after open-ended questions like 'Does that all make sense?' to let the customer respond naturally rather than filling silence with explanation.
